title: V6 Stage2a: DEV checks and prospective predictions for the reserved CONF subset
background_five_lines: Stage1 used 136 complete DEV participants (544 records) and frozen original PRRMrel B-cal readouts.
The primary deployed readout uses training z statistics and a ±3 clip; clipping affects short subrecords more strongly than full records.
The DEV decision, made before new CONF computations, assigns unclipped indices to variance/noise/agreement and clipped indices to SDS accuracy.
Stage1 showed across-record independent-error tension, while stored-position, adjacency and recorded-quality associations were not detected by the specified criteria.
Stage2a supplies DEV diagnostics and fixed numeric CONF predictions; Stage2b is locked until a manual registration receipt is supplied.
prior_exposure: No new CONF features, predictions, thinning, quality variables, accuracy, intervals or statistics were computed in V5 Stage1 or V6 Stage2a. Earlier full-sample analyses already included CONF: four-record ICC, single-record r, four-record r and participant-mean thinning. Frozen fold readouts used CONF labels in training. CLEAN means the registered quantity was not previously computed full-sample; it does not mean a pristine independent holdout.

analysis_conventions.thinning_seed_index: zero-based index within sorted complete cohort (participant,session), reset separately for each cohort
analysis_conventions.thinning_rng: numpy default_rng PCG64, channel-major then original cached frequency-major; one uniform per event; retain u<q; q=.8 nested in q=.9; same thinned trains for both readouts
analysis_conventions.full_accuracy: rstar: subtract the mean of each stored session position, then correlate pooled predictions with repeated SDS; recenter within each bootstrap
analysis_conventions.subrecord_accuracy: raw pooled H1/H2, Q1-Q4, C1/C2 or H13_1/H13_2 against repeated SDS; no additional centring; equal rows per participant
analysis_conventions.quarter_ICC: records as rows and quarters as columns; two-way consistency ICC; bootstrap people with all their records/quarters
analysis_conventions.prediction_SE: sample SD (ddof1) of finite 2000 bootstrap values
analysis_conventions.prediction_interval: DEV estimate +/- z * SE * sqrt(1+136/131); z=1.645/1.96; no clipping to admissible parameter range
analysis_conventions.numeric_pass: CONF point estimate inside closed 95% prediction interval
analysis_conventions.categorical_pass: registered boolean conditions or exact DEV label match; no numeric prediction interval for a category
analysis_conventions.overall: LOOCV only; 46fold reported separately, never selects the main verdict
analysis_conventions.missing: no imputation; exclude only observations needed by a metric, report counts; undefined estimates cannot pass

prediction_formula.interpretation: Approximate transfer prediction intervals, conditional on frozen readouts; they use the prespecified variance-inflation rule, not an independently estimated CONF variance.

label_rules.A2: WITHIN_RECORD_NONINDEPENDENCE if the95% lower bound of D_half or D_quarter is>0; otherwise NOT_DETECTED_WITHIN_RECORD
label_rules.A4: For each index separately: STEEPER_THAN_COUNTING if any95% upper bound of r(q)/r(1) is below q, across q=.9,.8 and rstar,r4; otherwise CONSISTENT_WITH_COUNTING. Unclipped is primary.
label_rules.A2_prespecified_interpretation: A detected label is the prespecified diagnostic for within-record dependence in disjoint event subsets, placing tension within event detection/feature construction rather than requiring state differences between records. This rule alone does not establish a unique causal mechanism.
label_rules.counting_floor_assumption: The supplied counting-floor model assumes the linear readout, expected features scaled by q, and counting noise unchanged in absolute units. Failure to reject this inequality does not establish the model.

verdict_rules.BUDGET_CONFIRMED: At least3 of P1a-P1d pass AND P1e AND P2c AND P4a AND P4b pass
verdict_rules.outside_verdict: P3 and P5-P8; P2a and P2b also do not enter the specified verdict; 46-fold scored separately without changing primary verdict

receipt_policy: REGISTRATION_RECEIPT.txt must contain an https:// or http:// URL and ISO8601 timestamp with timezone; script refuses missing/invalid/future receipt. No receipt is created by Stage2a.
receipt_status: ABSENT: no registration has occurred; SHA256 will be recorded by Stage2b after a receipt exists
limitations: DEV is half of a heavily explored cohort; one visit and one SDS per person.
Recording order is unverified; no confirmed temporal or state interpretation.
Intervals resample people only; one fixed thinning realization per record and q is conditioned upon.
No multiple-testing adjustment or equivalence test is added; failure to detect is not proof of zero.
Full rstar is position-centred; pooled subrecord accuracy is uncentred, as fixed before computations.
The scorer checks registration bytes and hashes of every executable dependency; software/environment versions are recorded separately.
